acceptance: A codex launch's argv carries -c check_for_update_on_startup=false (red first)
A fake pane showing the update menu never receives Enter while the cursor is on Update now, and boots once Skip is confirmed (red first on the current code)
No boot path sends a confirm key without a rule that observed the chosen option; the bespoke bootMenuSkip path is gone

consumed.resolution: Every realized codex-tmux launch carries -c check_for_update_on_startup=false from the manifest's default_args (go/internal/bridge/manifests/codex-tmux.json), so codex shows no update menu; if it shows anyway, update_menu_cursor_off_skip (Down) and update_menu_cursor_on_skip (Enter only on the observed Skip) answer it, and the bespoke bootMenuSkip/tmuxPaneLooksLikeUpdateMenu boot path is deleted (driver_tmux_boot.go, driver_codextmux.go). ADR-0118 addendum; pinned by codex_update_menu_verify_test.go.

fix: (1) Prevent: add `-c check_for_update_on_startup=false` (a real codex config key) to the codex-tmux manifest's launch args, so no update menu appears. (2) Defence, ADR-0118's pattern: replace the bespoke bootMenuSkip path with manifest rules, cursor on Update now -> Down (repeatable, bounded by the loop guard), cursor on Skip -> Enter, and delete bootMenuSkip/tmuxPaneLooksLikeUpdateMenu's blind send.
source: console, 2026-10-05, wave 59 codex dispatch failures (scout-escalation-report.json final_pane, cycle 1791)
summary: codex 0.153.4 opens with '✨ Update available! 0.153.4 -> 0.160.0' and a menu whose cursor starts on '› 1. Update now'. The boot's bespoke update-menu path (driver_codextmux.go bootMenuSkip "2", sent with Enter) did not move the cursor, so Enter confirmed Update now: codex ran `brew upgrade --cask codex` inside the sandbox, failed (Cellar not writable, cask pinned) and exited to the shell. Every prompt after that was typed into zsh ('nudge parked at the › input line', submit_wedged). In wave 59 (2026-10-05) all 16 codex dispatches failed this way (14 exit 81, 2 exit 80) and fell back to claude; the cli-health canary saw rc=81 and called it 'not a wall'. Same class as ADR-0118: a blind confirm on a menu whose default is destructive.
title: codex boots never confirm the update menu's 'Update now': the startup check is off, and the menu is answered only on the observed Skip
